Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 



DIMENSIONS FOR MODULAR UNITS FOR 
MACHINE TOOL CONSTRUCTION -ROTARY TABLES 



1. Scope — Specif ies certain dimensions relating to the interchangeability of rotary tables used in 
special purpose machines constructed from modular units. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 The dimensions of table diameter 320 to 2 000 mm shall be as specified below :

Note — It should be noted that drive units shown in the figure are only typical 
representations and not intended to define either their position or the type. Dimensions 
within bracket are non-preferred dimensions. 



3. Designation — A rotary table of diameter 630 mm and height 250 mm shall be designated as: 

Rotary Table 630 X 250 IS ; 10575

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from ISO : 3371-1975 'Modular 
units for machine tool construction — Rotary tables and multi-sided centre bases for rotary tables' 
issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).
